item.title: Security Council Sanctions Committee Established Pursuant to Resolution 1988 (2011) Amends Five Names on Its Sanctions List
item.description: SC/16494. On 29 October 2026, the 1988 Committee amended five individual entries on its 1988 Sanctions List: TAi.007 (Abdul Latif Mansoor), TAi.024 (Abdul Ghani Baradar), TAi.026 (Amir Khan Muttaqi), TAi.082 (Abdul-Haq Wasiq) and TAi.093 (Khairullah Khairkhwa). The measures are an assets freeze, a travel ban and an arms embargo under resolution 2816 (2026). The page does not show which fields changed; see the official Sanctions List for the exact edits. Updated list: https://main.un.org/securitycouncil/en/sanctions/1988/materials
